title: docc workspace output
description: What docc workspace --format json prints on one line, docc watch serves at /workspace.json and docc build --html inlines in <script id="docc-workspace" type="application/json">: everything a reader of the project shows. docc knows nothing of the tool that works on the project: the roles of kinds and the areas of code come from the "workspace" section of docc.json.

compile.description: The whole object of docc compile --hidden --format json (urn:docc:schema:compile:3, see docc schema compile): hidden documents included, marked hidden.

roles.description: Role -> a kind name or an array of kind names, as written, copied from workspace.roles of docc.json (tasks, checks, events, questions, meetings); a reader hides the section of a role that is absent. The documents of the meetings kinds are marked hidden in compile.tree (the Meetings tab lists them); docc watch writes the field «Ответ» of a document of a questions kind (POST /answer).

coverage.description: One row per block that its kind schema wants covered by code (x-docc-covered; visible documents in the tree).

text.description: Source text of the block without its code and the hashes of its links.

areas.description: Area -> the code tags that name the block (id#^code): every area of workspace.areas and code (the tags no area matches), each present, empty when no tag is there.

manual.description: A docIgnore entry for DOC404 on the block: the reason and who accepted it (by of the entry, agent when absent); null otherwise.

history.description: The commits of docc log --format json (see docc schema log: each with its trailers and actor, human or agent), newest first, at most 200; empty outside a Git work tree.

notes.description: Every *.md file directly in docs/inbox/notes/ of the project root, newest first; read-only (an agent writes them at a person's words). Empty when the folder is missing.

path.description: Relative to the project root, docs/inbox/notes/<name>.md.

title.description: The text of the first Markdown heading, else the file name without .md.

text.description: The Markdown of the file as written.

modified.description: Modification time of the file, UTC.

run.description: The content of the file at workspace.run of docc.json (the progress of the current run, written by a tool such as crew), or null when it is not set, missing or not JSON.

generatedAt.description: When the object was made, UTC.
